def MathResearch.Spinor.CompactSchurInput : ℕ → Measure CompactPair → Prop :=
fun n μK =>
  ∀ (u v : ↥(BinaryForm n)),
    ∫ (k : CompactPair), ‖inner ℂ v (((polynomialRepresentation n) (quaternionMatrix (↑k.2)⁻¹)) u)‖ ^ 2 ∂μK =
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 / (↑n + 1)
def MathResearch.Spinor.CoefficientHaarInput : (n : ℕ) →
  Measure Sp11 → Measure CompactPair → ↥(BinaryForm n) → (ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm n)) → Prop :=
fun n μG μK v f =>
  ∫ (g : Sp11), ‖liftedCoefficient n v f g‖ ^ 2 ∂μG =
    ∫ (q : ℍ) in Ball,
      (ballScale q)⁻¹ ^ 4 * ∫ (k : CompactPair), ‖inner ℂ v (fullLift n f (ballSection q * ↑(compactSp11 k)))‖ ^ 2 ∂μK

def MathResearch.Spinor.weakKernel : (n : ℕ) → 2 ≤ n → Submodule ℂ ↥(BallL2 n) :=
fun n hn => ⨅ φ, ⨅ j, ⨅ d, (↑(weakTest n hn φ j d)).ker
def MathResearch.Spinor.weakRowKernel : (m : ℕ) → 1 ≤ m → Submodule ℂ ↥(CompatibleBallL2 m) :=
fun m hm => Submodule.map (↑(spinorL2Isometry m).toLinearEquiv) (weakKernel (m + 1) ⋯)
def MathResearch.Spinor.weakSymbol : (n : ℕ) → Fin 4 → Fin 2 → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → ↥(BinaryForm n) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
fun n μ j d =>
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    { toFun := fun p => (spinorProjection n (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ) p j).coeff d, map_add' := ⋯,
      map_smul' := ⋯ }
def MathResearch.Spinor.weakTestVector : (n : ℕ) → BallTest → Fin 2 → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm n) :=
fun n φ j d q =>
  (ballDensity n q)⁻¹ •
    ∑ μ,
      (fderiv ℝ (⇑φ) q) (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ) • (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (weakSymbol n μ j d)) 1
def MathResearch.Spinor.weakTest : (n : ℕ) → 2 ≤ n → BallTest → Fin 2 → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → ↥(BallL2 n) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
fun n hn φ j d => (innerSL ℂ) (MemLp.toLp (weakTestVector n φ j d) ⋯)
def MathResearch.Spinor.liftedCoefficient : (n : ℕ) → ↥(BinaryForm n) → (ℍ → ↥(BinaryForm n)) → Sp11 → ℂ :=
fun n v f g => inner ℂ v (fullLift n f ↑g)
